translations.web: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.
translations.bsb: Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’ In tithes and offerings.
translations.kjv: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
